question: A trader mixes 26 kg of raw salt which costs Rs. 2 per kg with 30 kg of raw salt which costs Rs. 3.60 per kg. If he sells the mixture for Rs. 3 per kg, find his gain%.
solution:
**Given:**

The first type of quantity of salt = 26 kg

Cost of the first type of salt = Rs.2/kg

The second type of quantity of salt = 30 kg

Cost of the first type of salt = Rs.3.60/kg

**Formula used:**

Gain% = (profit × 100)/C.P

Profit = S.P - C.P

Where, C.P = cost price ; S.P = selling price

**Calculation:**

C.P of mixture of two quality of salt = {(2 × 26) + (3.6 × 30)}/(26 + 30)

⇒ (52 + 108)/56 = Rs.2.85

Gain% = {(3 - 2.85) × 100}/2.85

⇒ 15/2.85 = 5.26 ≈ 5%

**∴ The correct answer is 5%.**
